countdowns.name: GTA 6
countdowns.note: Grand Theft Auto VI, PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, midnight local time

facts.text: GTA 6 broke the all-time livestream record before it even unlocked: over 6.38 million people watching at once across platforms, crushing the old record of about 1.74 million (preliminary, Streams Charts).
GTA 6 hit a Twitch peak of about 3.06 million viewers at once (preliminary, Streams Charts).
The Grand Theft Auto series has sold nearly 480 million copies.
GTA VI Trailer 1 pulled 90,421,491 YouTube views in 24 hours, a Guinness World Record for a non-music video.
GTA 6 is the most-preordered game on the PlayStation and Xbox stores: about 12.1 million digital preorders, roughly $1.18 billion (Sensor Tower estimate, not official).
